trigger: Code audit found that the consolidated default/train/0000.parquet object belongs to the Hugging Face refs/convert/parquet revision, while the existing resolver requested the dataset main revision. The queued workflows had not started a source-gate job and no Hyperliquid event row or market outcome had been opened.

correction.revision_resolution: Resolve the exact refs/convert/parquet commit through the Hugging Face dataset revision API before any Parquet row is queried.
correction.sibling_check: Require the exact Parquet path to exist in the resolved revision metadata before opening DuckDB.
correction.transport: Retain the same DuckDB HTTP range reads, projection, predicate pushdown and exact 36 frozen _src identities.

unchanged: same six dates and six frozen UTC hours per date
same explicit LedgerUpdate liquidation schema and signed forced-flow interpretation
same model, features, structural target/stop, costs, sizing and one-global-slot contract
same prohibition on market price, future return, labels, model metrics, PnL, official 2026 and orders during the source gate
